display.text:
Why will the police have a difficult time?

The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers. At present, they are visiting all parts of the country. They will be arriving here tomorrow. They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club. The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days. During this time, they will give five performances.
As usual, the police will have a difficult time. They will be trying to keep order. It is always the same on these occasions.

display.bodyTextZh:
The Greenwood Boys 是一支流行歌手组合。目前，他们正在全国巡回演出。他们明天会到达这里。他们将乘火车前来，镇上的大多数年轻人都会在火车站迎接他们。
明晚他们将在工人俱乐部演出。格林伍德男孩们将在此逗留五天。在这段时间里，他们将进行五场演出。
像往常一样，警方会遇到很大的困难。他们会努力维持秩序。每逢这种场合，情况总是如此。
